name: Charlotte Izoard
original_name: シャルロット・イゾアール
source:
A friend of Ai's from the training group, who is only six years old. A first grader attending a French school in Kyoto, she speaks with a childish, uneasy Japanese. She starts to be interested in shogi because of Naruto.

[Taken from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Ryuo%27s_Work_is_Never_Done!]Wikipedia[/url]]
